name: Picture Challenge
about: Personalities, monuments and sports (10 each), brand and Indian company logos (19) and national flags (24). Brand logos are each brand's current logo: the multicolour ones as Wikidata records them (fetched from Wikimedia Commons with their licence on import), the single-colour ones (Apple, Adidas, Starbucks, WhatsApp, Android) as clean vector icons from Simple Icons (CC0). Company logos that spell out the company's name have just their emblem cut out on import (plain cropping, no AI). The logos stay trademarks of their owners. Flags come from flagcdn.com (public domain). The other pictures are each named by a Wikipedia article: on import the server asks Wikipedia for that article's actual main picture and its licence; a picture that is not freely licensed is refused, and every picture fetched that way is marked Needs Review. Every picture must load. No AI, no paid API: to add more, upload your own pictures with Add question.
